name: FreeFCC
description: Free FCC unlock for DJI smart controllers. No server, no license, no tracking. Download: freefcc.pages.dev

paragraphs: A free and open-source Android app that unlocks FCC mode, sends 4G activation frames, and queries device info on DJI smart controllers with a screen (RC2, RC Pro 2, RC Plus). No server. No license. No tracking. Just raw DUML commands from JSON profile files.

## Disclaimer This software is provided for educational and research purposes only. Modifying radio transmission parameters may violate laws and regulations in your country or region.
